title: Season + erosion-intensity force dials (C-021 / C-022)
simLoop: Season pressure scales how strongly the seasonal establishment tick pushes every guild (day-length/phenology referent, distinct from Heat's temperature gate); erosion intensity scales the existing hillslope + coastal erosion terms only (never soil production) under one GEO-002 law. Both are static force-dial multipliers, neutral at 1, with no cell arguments.
gameLoop: If I set the season dial to long and the erosion dial to stormy, growth should push harder across the whole preserve and the same slope should wear down faster — without either dial ever targeting a place or duplicating Heat.
notebookSeed: Turn the season up and the hollow grows faster; turn the storms up and the same slope wears down quicker — the place answers to how hard each force works, not to where you point.
tierO: no owner-only question this closeout — machine half only (CI-judged: no-targeting, paired divergence, mass conservation); Lock taste sitting deferred to the owner (C-021/C-022 dossiers)
